sheet: Roslyn VFW Dart League Results Scan Sheet
coordinate_system: Normalized to corner-marker centres: (0,0)=TL, (1,0)=TR, (0,1)=BL; y down.
fiducial_note: Solid black squares; TL has white notch for orientation.
reading_rules: Each tens/ones row: exactly one bubble filled. Team total hundreds = single flag bubble (filled=100); shooter max 99, team max 199. Winners: one of home/away per group. Digits printed medium gray; threshold fill darkness above digit ink.
